digest.component_or_area: store push subsystem (push.py, push_classify.py, push_recovery.py, push_state.py)
propositions: Expected and self-healing best-effort tickets-branch push failures (lost contention races, transient retries, routine backlog) are logged at WARNING with wording that primes LLM agents to assume store corruption, causing unnecessary investigation and token burn.
Mid-retry transient transport retry notices are logged at INFO despite being automatically handled, emitting pure worry-bait without operator-actionable signals.
The unpushed_summary suffix displays bare `..HEAD` (session tracker HEAD, not code worktree HEAD) and escalates count across concurrent sessions without stating the self-healing contract.
Expected-case contention outcomes must be demoted from INFO to DEBUG (or entirely suppressed at INFO+) while policy declines, strict failures, and proven-growing backlog remain WARNING.

All backlog messages must name the tickets branch explicitly (no bare `..HEAD`), state that commits are locally published on next successful push, and explicitly claim no action needed under normal concurrent-writer load.
A proven-growing backlog (prior marker unpushed count is smaller) escalates terminal contention failure to WARNING; ambiguous or static growth resolves to False/DEBUG.
